name: vantage.nvim
description: A Neovim-first AI review and learning assistant with a local TypeScript backend.
author: Nick Pisani

scripts.test:backend: npm run clean:server && npm run compile && node --test 'server/out/neovim/**/*.test.js'
scripts.test:nvim: mkdir -p .nvim-dev/state/nvim && XDG_STATE_HOME=.nvim-dev/state NVIM_LOG_FILE=.nvim-dev/state/nvim/test.log nvim --headless -u nvim/tests/minimal_init.lua -c "lua require('vantage_spec').run()" -c qa
scripts.test:mvp: npm run test:backend && npm run test:nvim
